text: This is Ad Spotter, a Chrome extension that finds ads by reading the page, not by matching a block list.
It runs Fastino's GLiNER two point five Decide model on your GPU with WebGPU. The model downloads once, and page text never leaves the browser.
Each block of the page gets one question: is this a paid ad, editorial content, or page furniture? The sponsored post, the banner and the sidebar ad light up, each with a confidence score.
Ads injected after the page loads are caught too, as the page changes.
Switch to remove mode, and the same scores hide the ads instead. The article, the comments and the newsletter stay put.
The popup shows the model running on WebGPU at about a hundred milliseconds per block, with counts for the current tab.
Ad Spotter is open source on GitHub.
